en.text: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),

zhSimplified.text: 十二月，乃亚达月十三日，王的谕旨将要举行，就是犹大人的仇敌盼望辖制他们的日子，犹大人反倒辖制恨他们的人。

zhTraditional.text: 十二月，乃亞達月十三日，王的諭旨將要舉行，就是猶大人的仇敵盼望轄制他們的日子，猶大人反倒轄制恨他們的人。

en.text: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大人在亚哈随鲁王各省的城里聚集，下手击杀那要害他们的人。无人能敌挡他们，因为各族都惧怕他们。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大人在亞哈隨魯王各省的城裏聚集，下手擊殺那要害他們的人。無人能敵擋他們，因為各族都懼怕他們。

en.text: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

zhSimplified.text: 各省的首领、总督、省长，和办理王事的人，因惧怕末底改，就都帮助犹大人。

zhTraditional.text: 各省的首領、總督、省長，和辦理王事的人，因懼怕末底改，就都幫助猶大人。

en.text: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.

zhSimplified.text: 末底改在朝中为大，名声传遍各省，日渐昌盛。

zhTraditional.text: 末底改在朝中為大，名聲傳遍各省，日漸昌盛。

en.text: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大人用刀击杀一切仇敌，任意杀灭恨他们的人。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大人用刀擊殺一切仇敵，任意殺滅恨他們的人。

en.text: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

zhSimplified.text: 在书珊城，犹大人杀灭了五百人；

zhTraditional.text: 在書珊城，猶大人殺滅了五百人；

en.text: They killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,

zhSimplified.text: 又杀巴珊大他、达分、亚斯帕他、

zhTraditional.text: 又殺巴珊大他、達分、亞斯帕他、

en.text: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,

zhSimplified.text: 破拉他、亚大利雅、亚利大他、

zhTraditional.text: 破拉他、亞大利雅、亞利大他、

en.text: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha,

zhSimplified.text: 帕玛斯他、亚利赛、亚利代、瓦耶撒他；

zhTraditional.text: 帕瑪斯他、亞利賽、亞利代、瓦耶撒他；

en.text: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

zhSimplified.text: 这十人都是哈米大他的孙子、犹大人仇敌哈曼的儿子。犹大人却没有下手夺取财物。

zhTraditional.text: 這十人都是哈米大他的孫子、猶大人仇敵哈曼的兒子。猶大人卻沒有下手奪取財物。

en.text: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.

zhSimplified.text: 当日，将书珊城被杀的人数呈在王前。

zhTraditional.text: 當日，將書珊城被殺的人數呈在王前。

en.text: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”

zhSimplified.text: 王对王后以斯帖说：「犹大人在书珊城杀灭了五百人，又杀了哈曼的十个儿子，在王的各省不知如何呢？现在你要什么，我必赐给你；你还求什么，也必为你成就。」

zhTraditional.text: 王對王后以斯帖說：「猶大人在書珊城殺滅了五百人，又殺了哈曼的十個兒子，在王的各省不知如何呢？現在你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你還求甚麼，也必為你成就。」

en.text: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

zhSimplified.text: 以斯帖说：「王若以为美，求你准书珊的犹大人，明日也照今日的旨意行，并将哈曼十个儿子的尸首挂在木架上。」

zhTraditional.text: 以斯帖說：「王若以為美，求你准書珊的猶大人，明日也照今日的旨意行，並將哈曼十個兒子的屍首掛在木架上。」

en.text: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

zhSimplified.text: 王便允准如此行。旨意传在书珊，人就把哈曼十个儿子的尸首挂起来了。

zhTraditional.text: 王便允准如此行。旨意傳在書珊，人就把哈曼十個兒子的屍首掛起來了。

en.text: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

zhSimplified.text: 亚达月十四日，书珊的犹大人又聚集在书珊，杀了三百人，却没有下手夺取财物。

zhTraditional.text: 亞達月十四日，書珊的猶大人又聚集在書珊，殺了三百人，卻沒有下手奪取財物。

en.text: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

zhSimplified.text: 在王各省其余的犹大人也都聚集保护性命，杀了恨他们的人七万五千，却没有下手夺取财物。这样，就脱离仇敌，得享平安。

zhTraditional.text: 在王各省其餘的猶大人也都聚集保護性命，殺了恨他們的人七萬五千，卻沒有下手奪取財物。這樣，就脫離仇敵，得享平安。

en.text: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

zhSimplified.text: 亚达月十三日，行了这事；十四日安息，以这日为设筵欢乐的日子。

zhTraditional.text: 亞達月十三日，行了這事；十四日安息，以這日為設筵歡樂的日子。

en.text: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

zhSimplified.text: 但书珊的犹大人，这十三日、十四日聚集杀戮仇敌；十五日安息，以这日为设筵欢乐的日子。

zhTraditional.text: 但書珊的猶大人，這十三日、十四日聚集殺戮仇敵；十五日安息，以這日為設筵歡樂的日子。

en.text: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.

zhSimplified.text: 所以住无城墙乡村的犹大人，如今都以亚达月十四日为设筵欢乐的吉日，彼此馈送礼物。

zhTraditional.text: 所以住無城牆鄉村的猶大人，如今都以亞達月十四日為設筵歡樂的吉日，彼此餽送禮物。

en.text: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

zhSimplified.text: 末底改记录这事，写信与亚哈随鲁王各省远近所有的犹大人，

zhTraditional.text: 末底改記錄這事，寫信與亞哈隨魯王各省遠近所有的猶大人，

en.text: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

zhSimplified.text: 嘱咐他们每年守亚达月十四、十五两日，

zhTraditional.text: 囑咐他們每年守亞達月十四、十五兩日，

en.text: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.

zhSimplified.text: 以这月的两日为犹大人脱离仇敌得平安、转忧为喜、转悲为乐的吉日。在这两日设筵欢乐，彼此馈送礼物，周济穷人。

zhTraditional.text: 以這月的兩日為猶大人脫離仇敵得平安、轉憂為喜、轉悲為樂的吉日。在這兩日設筵歡樂，彼此餽送禮物，賙濟窮人。

en.text: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,

zhSimplified.text: 于是，犹大人按着末底改所写与他们的信，应承照初次所守的守为永例；

zhTraditional.text: 於是，猶大人按着末底改所寫與他們的信，應承照初次所守的守為永例；

en.text: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

zhSimplified.text: 是因犹大人的仇敌亚甲族哈米大他的儿子哈曼设谋杀害犹大人，掣普珥，就是掣签，为要杀尽灭绝他们；

zhTraditional.text: 是因猶大人的仇敵亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼設謀殺害猶大人，掣普珥，就是掣籤，為要殺盡滅絕他們；

en.text: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

zhSimplified.text: 这事报告于王，王便降旨使哈曼谋害犹大人的恶事归到他自己的头上，并吩咐把他和他的众子都挂在木架上。

zhTraditional.text: 這事報告於王，王便降旨使哈曼謀害猶大人的惡事歸到他自己的頭上，並吩咐把他和他的眾子都掛在木架上。

en.text: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,

footnotes.text: 9:26 Purim is the Hebrew plural for pur, which means lot.

zhSimplified.text: 照着普珥的名字，犹大人就称这两日为「普珥日」。他们因这信上的话，又因所看见所遇见的事，

zhTraditional.text: 照着普珥的名字，猶大人就稱這兩日為「普珥日」。他們因這信上的話，又因所看見所遇見的事，

en.text: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

zhSimplified.text: 就应承自己与后裔，并归附他们的人，每年按时必守这两日，永远不废。

zhTraditional.text: 就應承自己與後裔，並歸附他們的人，每年按時必守這兩日，永遠不廢。

en.text: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.

zhSimplified.text: 各省各城、家家户户、世世代代纪念遵守这两日，使这「普珥日」在犹大人中不可废掉，在他们后裔中也不可忘记。

zhTraditional.text: 各省各城、家家戶戶、世世代代紀念遵守這兩日，使這「普珥日」在猶大人中不可廢掉，在他們後裔中也不可忘記。

en.text: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

zhSimplified.text: 亚比孩的女儿—王后以斯帖和犹大人末底改以全权写第二封信，坚嘱犹大人守这「普珥日」，

zhTraditional.text: 亞比孩的女兒－王后以斯帖和猶大人末底改以全權寫第二封信，堅囑猶大人守這「普珥日」，

en.text: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,

zhSimplified.text: 用和平诚实话写信给亚哈随鲁王国中一百二十七省所有的犹大人，

zhTraditional.text: 用和平誠實話寫信給亞哈隨魯王國中一百二十七省所有的猶大人，

en.text: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.

zhSimplified.text: 劝他们按时守这「普珥日」，禁食呼求，是照犹大人末底改和王后以斯帖所嘱咐的，也照犹大人为自己与后裔所应承的。

zhTraditional.text: 勸他們按時守這「普珥日」，禁食呼求，是照猶大人末底改和王后以斯帖所囑咐的，也照猶大人為自己與後裔所應承的。

en.text: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

zhSimplified.text: 以斯帖命定守「普珥日」，这事也记录在书上。

zhTraditional.text: 以斯帖命定守「普珥日」，這事也記錄在書上。
